turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ProtectQA support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Hi Sarah, I'm calling about my account. I was charged twice for my subscription.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into your account right away. Can you please provide your account number?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. I can see the duplicate charge here. You were charged $29.99 twice on January 15th.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes, exactly. Can you refund the extra charge?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Absolutely. I'll process the refund right now. It should appear in your account within 3-5 business days.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: That's great. Thank you so much for your help.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: No, that's all. Have a great day!
